parent_identity.reconciliation: Recompute original V1.7 first signal per symbol/NY week from the chosen frozen 12H/H1 input and compare every parent key, side, reference entry/stop/target and prior ATR before searching later bars.

candidate_rule.parent: original first-per-symbol/week frozen V1.7 key; its source row and Monday anchor are immutable
candidate_rule.repeat: first later native 12H V1.7 same-side strict wick-through and close-inside reclaim of the same Monday 1.618 boundary, with confirmed EMA20/50 aligned to the original side
candidate_rule.time: candidate confirmation strictly after parent confirmation and strictly before that same NY week expires; no next-week anchor
candidate_rule.continuous_outside: excluded by the source strict close-inside rule; at most one repeat per parent week
candidate_rule.entry: the H1 open at exactly candidate confirmation_ms; missing exact hour remains a candidate audit status and is never shifted
candidate_rule.lookahead: candidate scan uses only each closed 12H bar, completed Monday anchor and that bar's closed EMA; no exit or P&L field is read from the parent ledger

stop_and_risk.stop: source fixed_stop on the same touched-side 1.618 reference from the parent's frozen NY Monday range; recomputed at the second key
stop_and_risk.risk: abs(actual candidate H1 entry open - recomputed stop); 2R target uses actual entry plus side*2*risk
stop_and_risk.entry_at_or_beyond_stop: retained and sent to the VectorBT callback for immediate native open-stop handling; separately counted
stop_and_risk.zero_risk: retained in native real path behavior; existing control matcher semantics leave it unmatched

own_time_90d.source: existing cloud_close_leadership.leadership(), exact (entry_ms,symbol) index and membership gate
own_time_90d.eligibility: coverage rank is nonnull only when the frozen 90-day return has the existing minimum cross-sectional coverage (10 contracts); controls must also qualify at their own time
own_time_90d.priority: entry_order is the event's own previous-confirmed 12H Wilder ATR14 / prior close percentage; ascending means lower ATR first; missing values sort last as +inf

control_matching.method: seeded random non-signal 12H confirmation, same symbol/NY week/side and aligned EMA20/50; strictly later than its second-reclaim event; own-time eligible and previous confirmed ATR14/close within the frozen relative tolerance; one without-replacement draw
control_matching.unmatched_controls: recorded in candidate audit and coverage; never added as an executable account row
control_matching.interpretation: matched controls are retrospective diagnostics, not executable primary-entry gating

execution.engine: existing VectorBT Portfolio.from_order_func callback in cloud_close_reward_paths._simulate_symbol
execution.runner_exit: original cloud/stop/stale/gap/tail rules from frozen V1.7 path callback
execution.independent_paths: one-base-unit columns, cash_sharing=false; funding/account/capacity not simulated here
execution.slippage_funding_multiplier: not modeled in this independent path builder
